comments.author: Unusual-Candle-8090
comments.body: I've found that one easy way to increase quality is to find a good set of skills for the engine you're using. E.g. [https://github.com/jame581/GodotPrompter](https://github.com/jame581/GodotPrompter) for Godot

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: You went full agentic for gamedev? Why? Lol

comments.author: mechaghost
comments.body: Are you doing multi camera visual verification? I do that for my vibe coded games to help give claude more context

replies.author: Mental-Frosting-7752
replies.body: Can you explain a bit? Im interested

replies.author: mechaghost
replies.body: Basically ask Claude to make a skill to take multiple screenshots of whatever you want verified. So let’s say you’re putting down some prop in 3D having Claude make a tool within the game to take screenshots from all angles help inform it if it did it right. Obviously if it’s 2D then you just have 1 angle but you can force it to zoom in to parts of the screen to verify, zoom works on 3D too. Claude is really good at doing visual verification you just need to make it easy and remind it from time to time to use it
